errors_encountered.solution: Uninstalled existing package via adb_uninstall then streamed install fresh debug APK

errors_encountered.error: TTS engine hanging or failing to invoke onDone/onError leaves audio ducking active indefinitely
errors_encountered.solution: Added 6-second watchdog timer in FocusModeTtsManager that automatically abandons duck audio focus

errors_encountered.error: Rapid GPS refresh clicks causing multiple concurrent scan jobs and freezing UI
errors_encountered.solution: Added active scanJob guard and 8-second GPS timeout with fallback error messaging
